name: Workers (symbol)
spec: orange diamond with a black worker-with-shovel symbol
meaning: Workers are on or near the road; slow down.

snippets.back: Do not drive across a fire hose without a fire-department official's consent; the handbook warns of damage and danger to rescue workers.
Work-zone signs also warn of a flagman ahead, workers in or near the road, and mowing equipment ahead.
When workers are present, a moving traffic violation in a work zone carries double the usual fine.
Five groups are known to be at higher crash risk from sleepiness: shift workers, business travelers, commercial drivers, people with sleep disorders and young people.

Drivers under twenty-one carry no alcohol without a companion twenty-one or older, containers full sealed and unopened with opened ones in trunks or non-passenger spots, except workers for off-site liquor licensees with closed containers.
In a work or construction zone, protect crews and other road users by shifting your lane position away from workers and slowing down for obstacles.

Groups at special risk for fatigue-related crashes include sixteen- to twenty-four-year-olds who often need extra sleep, people with untreated obstructive sleep apnea facing seven times the risk of falling asleep at the wheel, night-shift workers facing nearly six times the risk, and rotating-shift or over-sixty-hour-a-week workers who must be especially careful.
Be patient when workers, equipment or alternating single-lane traffic require a temporary stop.

result.summary: AL states work-zone signs warn of workers in or near the road, and CO states to protect crews by shifting away and slowing down; no snippet describes orange diamond shape/colour/symbol.
